reproduction.rationale: Reproduction requires independently executed analysis and source-native granular verification across complete2h+5e, with all source-PC/time/draw outputs and companions; supplied-score recomputation is insufficient. Neither outcome has authenticated complete cohort/grid/split/observation/evaluator/analysis/verifier/input/code manifests, exposure policy or matched cumulative budgets. Therefore paper+data and paper+data+author-code remain unbound with unknown scientific outcomes; no reduced panel or default grid is substituted.
